label: Knights of Guinevere · Fusion · Automate des bassins
identity: A genuinely redesigned frog-shaped amusement-park automaton. Ribbit's recognizable two immense white eyes and wedge pupils sit in round lime enamel housings above an elegant lime porcelain frog face with pink cheek discs and wide smile. The body is built from cream and mint porcelain shell segments with royal-blue floral motifs, exposed brass ring joints at elbows/knees, dark inner mechanical links; slim curved arms, sturdy elongated spring-jointed frog legs and broad articulated three-toed paddle feet. Small wind-up key mounted behind torso, a cream oval belly hatch bordered brass, pink bow-shaped enamel collar. The two spring coils inside rear-leg joints are structural; no detached pieces. Rounded blue shoulder shells and tasteful brass trim. Reimagine the anatomy as one coherent frog machine, not a frog wearing armor. No human face, jester cap, bells or knight sword. Entire key and all toes in frame.
